summary: Renasant Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $300M offering of 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes mature June 1, 2036, with a fixed rate for five years then floating at SOFR plus 245 bps. Redeemable at par on or after June 1, 2031, or upon a Tier 2 Capital Event. Underwritten by Keefe Bruyette Woods and others at 98.75% of par. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
